subject.title: fix: prevent silent message loss from EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError

question: Should `settings.retry.provider.maxRetries` deliberately retry the whole primary-to-fallback reply cycle after the embedded prompt-lock window disables SDK-local retries?
rationale: The branch prevents in-window retries from racing the released session lock, but moving an existing configured retry budget to the orchestrator changes established request, fallback, latency, and billing semantics; source inspection cannot choose that user-facing policy safely.

options.title: Preserve provider-local semantics
options.body: Keep configured provider retries at a compatible provider boundary and use only a separately defined, bounded outer recovery path that cannot run inside the released-lock window.

options.title: Adopt whole-cycle retries explicitly
options.body: Approve the new outer-cycle meaning, document its fallback and billing effects, and add upgrade-focused coverage for configured retry budgets.

options.title: Pause for retry-contract decision
options.body: Do not merge until an owner selects the retry scope and the branch is refreshed against current main with proof for that selected contract.

recommendation.title: Pause for retry-contract decision
recommendation.body: Do not merge until an owner selects the retry scope and the branch is refreshed against current main with proof for that selected contract.
